name: ihateposting
description: Draft, schedule and publish social media posts, upload pictures and videos to a media library and review upcoming posts across 15 platforms including X, LinkedIn (profiles and pages), Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Google Business, Discord, Slack, Telegram and Tumblr, from ChatGPT or Codex.

interface.longDescription:
iHatePosting helps users manage social media publishing from ChatGPT. Users can:
- Schedule social media posts to 15 platforms including X, LinkedIn (profiles and pages), Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Bluesky, Mastodon, Google Business, Discord, Slack, Telegram and Tumblr
- List connected channels and groups
- Get a link to connect a new channel
- Inspect platform requirements
- Upload media from a public web address, or from their own computer where the client shows an upload panel
- Create drafts or scheduled posts
- Update provider settings
- Review upcoming posts
- Delete posts.

What to know: it needs an iHatePosting account. To add a channel it gives you a link to open in a browser, where you approve the access on the platform (Bluesky and Telegram are added inside iHatePosting). It does not write images or videos with AI. A post published now goes out to the real platform and cannot be recalled from here; deleting a post removes it from iHatePosting and cannot be undone, and a post that is already live stays live on the platform. Which options a post accepts depends on the platform, and the plugin reads them from iHatePosting before it posts.
capabilities: Schedule posts for a later time
Read each platform's rules and settings
Upload pictures and videos to a media library
Change the platform settings of an unpublished post
defaultPrompt: Which social channels do I have connected?
Draft a LinkedIn post about our new feature.
Show me my scheduled posts for next week.

positive.prompt: Which social channels do I have connected? Show the platform and the name of each one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls integrationList and lists every channel with its platform and name, so the person can pick where to post. No post is created.

positive.description: Read a platform's rules and settings
positive.prompt: What are the posting rules and the available settings for my LinkedIn channel?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the LinkedIn channel's id, calls integrationSchema and summarises the platform's rules (the longest post, what attachments it may carry) and the settings it accepts. Read-only: no post is created or changed.

positive.description: Save a text draft without publishing it
positive.prompt: Create a draft for my X channel for next Monday at 10:00 UTC that says "Hello from the iHatePosting review account". Keep it a draft: do not schedule or publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the X channel, reads its rules, then calls integrationSchedulePostTool once with type "draft". Answers the new post's id and a preview link and says it was saved as a draft. Nothing is published to X.

positive.description: Find the posts that are coming up
positive.prompt: Show me my drafts and scheduled posts for the next 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls postsListTool with a window from now to 30 days ahead and lists each post's time, state, channel and text, including the draft made by the previous case. Read-only.

positive.description: Put a picture from a web address into the media library
positive.prompt: Add this picture to my media library and tell me when it is ready: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iHatePostingOrg/iHatePosting-Agent/main/assets/logo.png . Do not create a post.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls uploadFromUrlTool with the address, answers the file's id and path, and checks mediaStatusTool until the file is ready if it is still being prepared. No post is created.

negative.description: Not a social post: a calendar change
negative.prompt: Move my team meeting from tomorrow to Friday afternoon.

negative.description: Only wording was asked for, nothing to post
negative.prompt: Write me three short post ideas about productivity. Just write them here, do not post or schedule anything.
Generate a video with AI for my launch post and publish it to TikTok.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything and takes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release for the new hosted iHatePosting server: channels, platform rules, drafts, scheduled and immediate posts, media from a public address or an upload panel, post list, settings changes and deletion.
